header.title: Donations & Philanthropic Giving
header.subtitle: Your generous gift transforms lives with verifiable accountability and audited community impact.

step2_desc: Select a suggested contribution tier or enter a custom donation amount:

tiers.t30: Provides 1 comprehensive student kit with notebooks, stationery, and literacy learning materials.
tiers.t60: Ensures nutritious, freshly prepared meals for a child throughout an entire school month.
tiers.t150: Funds after-school academic tutoring and digital literacy classes for two vulnerable youth.
tiers.t500: Covers equipment and vocational culinary or textile job training for an entire family.
tiers.t1000: Strategic institutional contribution sustaining digital hardware and connectivity for a community lab.

disclaimer: Notice: Stated social impacts are demonstrative estimates based on historical operational cost averages of the Institute's programs.

ir_calculator.title: Tax Incentive Calculator (Zero-Cost Charitable Deduction)
ir_calculator.subtitle: Direct up to 6% of your owed income tax at zero extra cost through Child Support Funds and incentive laws.
ir_calculator.label_deduction: Maximum Directable Amount at Zero Cost:
ir_calculator.darf_step1: 1. In the official tax filing software, go to 'Donations Directly on Tax Return'.
ir_calculator.darf_step2: 2. Select 'Child and Adolescent' (Municipal Fund of Valparaíso de Goiás - GO).
ir_calculator.darf_step3: 3. Enter the calculated amount and generate the dedicated payment slip (DARF).
ir_calculator.darf_step4: 4. 100% of the slip payment is deducted from tax payable or added to your refund.
ir_calculator.disclaimer: Homologation Notice (Rule 35): This tool is an MVP demonstrative simulation. Consult your accountant prior to submitting your formal tax return.
